ops.reason: nose block: a loop just behind the nose pad so the pad reads as its own block
mouth line along the muzzle side, fan terminators at the nose and on the cheek
neck base: loop between the neck and the withers for the head-down bend
mid neck: loop between the throat rings so the neck arcs instead of kinking
shoulder: loop round the foreleg root above the elbow
elbow: loop below the elbow for the bend
stifle: loop in the thigh above the stifle
eye socket: a loop inside the eye plane under the brow
rump: a crease hugging the top-back corner so the rump rounds off instead of a slab
